name: Starburst MCP
description: Query Starburst Galaxy clusters and catalogs with read-only SQL and explore schemas from Claude, Cline, GitHub Copilot, or other MCP clients over a hosted server.

skills.name: Cluster And Catalog Discovery
skills.description: Discovers the Galaxy clusters, catalogs, schemas, and tables your role can access so an assistant understands your data layout.

skills.name: Read-Only SQL Queries
skills.description: Runs read-only SELECT, SHOW, and EXPLAIN statements against your Galaxy data through natural language, capped at 100KB of results.

skills.name: Schema Documentation
skills.description: Generates documentation for data schemas, table structures, and catalog contents in Starburst Galaxy from plain-language requests.
